Name: Phil
Dialog: Oh, boy! Did that kid stink or what? But maybe YOU'VE got what it takes to be: The Next Super American Pop Teen Idol Star! Auditions open today at the (zooms out to reveal that the advert is playing on the TV in the dining room/kitchen where the boys eating cereal.) Googolplex Mall in beautiful downtown Danville.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Auditions! Today?!

Name: Phil
Dialog: Yes, today! At two o'clock sharp.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Grabs the TV and kisses it) I've gotta tell Stacy! (Runs, bringing the TV with her and falls) Oh!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That pop star stuff might be fun at first, but then you'd be stuck in a dead end job. Too bad you can't just do it once and move on.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Well, what you're talking about is a one-hit wonder.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: One-hit wonder? What's that?

Name: Linda
Dialog: (Phineas starts creating the checklist offscreen) Well, a musical act (Flashes back to a time when Linda was known as a singer named Lindana.) goes to the top of the charts with a catchy tune and meaningless lyrics...

Name: Linda
Dialog: (cntd) Then they throw a big diva tantrum, lose their label, and they fade to obscurity. Before you know it, their song ends up as elevator music.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (cntd;) Years later, they have a reunion concert...

Name: Singers and Lindana
Dialog: Fun fun fun!

Name: Singers and Lindana
Dialog: (Ripples back to her in the dining room, upset.) And after that, they never sing again. And no one... remembers them. (stares off into space, but quickly turns back to the boys) Not that I would know anything about that.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (finishing) A one-hit wonder... (Shows checklist, listing in order: Hit record, Diva tantrum, Elevator music, Reunion tour) Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today. (Ferb strums a guitar.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, what am I going to sing?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Hello? What are you gonna wear?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hmmm... (In a montage, it cuts to her wearing a blue gown.) What do you think?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Too much.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (Candace wears a bikini) Too little.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (Candace wears a pinafore.) Ugh, too clean.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (Candace wears torn cords and a hippie t-shirt.) Too dirty.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (Candace wears a street clothing.) Too street.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (Candace wears a goth suit.) Too goth.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Where'd you get that?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (wearing a Lindana costume) From my mom's closet. You like it?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Nah, too retro. (Candace tries more other outfits: a construction uniform, Indian clothes, cowgirl duds, biking clothes, a sailor suit, a gorilla costume, a spacesuit, a clown costume, and finally ends up with her trademark clothing.) Perfect!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Nice, huh?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Yeah, you should've tried that on first.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Let's go!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (The girls pass by the brothers in their bedroom; on the floor writing.) "Chika, chika, choo...wah". Meaningless lyrics done. (To Ferb) How's the catchy tune coming along? (Ferb presses a key on the computer keyboard, producing a piano sound in the key of D.) Excellent! We'll be done by lunch! Hey, where'd Perry go?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Hello? Hello-oo? Anybody there? (Perry crashes down, full of water) Oh, good morning Agent P. We just received word that Dr. Doofenshmirtz has been buying up construction toys at an alarming rate. We need you to find out what he's up to and put a stop to it. (Perry salutes and leaves with his scooter, and stops at the red light. Linda's car stops beside him, and she glances; then when she realized it, Perry puts a pair of Groucho glasses on and Linda just shrugs. The green light then appears and he zooms away.)

Name: Linda
Dialog: We'll meet back at the entrance in an hour.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Inside...) Come on, Stacy! We've gotta hurry so we could get a spot in li -- yayaya. (realized the line's too long) I've never sang in front of so many people!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Uh, Candace? (shows her a LOT more people in the audience)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (gasps) I can't do this.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh yes, you can! You're not a quitter; you're a fighter!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I am?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Sure you are! You're a lean, mean, singing machine! (Candace growls and punches the purse as in boxing.) That's it, yeah! Now you're looking like a winner! (Candace looks like a worn out tiger and drools.)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (walks by) Hey, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (arranges herself) And that is what a gorilla looks like when you try to take away its food. Oh! Hi, Jeremy! Are you auditioning too?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Nah. I came to see this hot new band called PFT. I downloaded their song this morning. It's tight! The hundredth contestant gets to sing onstage with the band!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Really? (She walks through the entrance and becomes the 100th contestant.)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, looks like that's you.

Name: Phil
Dialog: Congratulations! You're the hundredth contestant! (Pulls her away and puts her onstage; over speaker) Ladies and gentlemen, this young lady has the honor of singing onstage with PFT. So now, the band you've been waiting for: Phineas and the Ferb-Tones!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (her boys are revealed; **Song: "Gitchee Gitchee Goo"**) Phineas?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Candace? You're the hundredth contestant? How serendipitous. This'll be like a brother-sister thing! Now I'm assuming you've heard our single. I mean, who hasn't, right? It's a big hit. (gives her sheet music) So here's the words; but don't worry if you get lost. The lyrics are meaningless anyway. I'll point when it's your turn. (He steps forward as Candace stares.) Ladies and gentlemen, the Ferbettes! I'm Phineas and this is Ferb, and we're gonna sing a song!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (looks at her music sheet before throwing it aside) Wait a minute! What are you doing?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I'm cueing you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: How did you get a hit single?!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, it wasn't easy. It took most of the morning and half a dozen phone calls. But if you're willing to put in the work-

Name: Candace
Dialog: That's it! I'm gonna tell Mom!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay...tell her what?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (pauses) Ooh, I'm just gonna tell. (She walks offstage)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Linda is in a store.) Mom! Mom! Mom! Mom, you've gotta see this!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (with disdain) Let me guess. Is it unbelieva- (Candace pushes her) WOOAH!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Come on, come on, come on!

Name: Man
Dialog: (Backstage...) Hi, I'm Ben Baxter, Huge-O-Records. Why don't you come by my office in an hour and we can talk about your future.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Future? Cool. He must be a psychic.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Come on, come on, come on! (She and Linda arrive at the stage; she presents a shadow that appears to be Phineas and Ferb's heads.) See?! There they are onstage!!

Name: Phil
Dialog: Ladies and gentlemen, once again... (Spotlight lights up to reveal:) Marty the Rabbit Boy and His Musical Blender! (Marty the Rabbit Boy performs, playing his blender to The Blue Danube Waltz.)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hon, we're getting you an eye exam. (pulls her away)

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, no! Wait!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha ha, everything is ready! (doorbell rings) Oh, what is it now? (opens the door and saw the disguised Perry) Oh, are you my new temp? Well, let me just get you up to speed. I know it's bit of a mess. I'm just putting the finishing touches on my latest maniacal plan. You see, in a few minutes, I will unleash an unprecedented reign of terror upon the entire... (holds a magnifying glass on the eastern coast of the U.S.) ...Tri-State Area! And Perry the Platypus will never be the wiser. (Agent P removes the Groucho glasses) Perry the Platypus? You're a temp? Are times that hard?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (exits the mall, wearing glasses.) Ugh! I told Mom I don't need glasses! (takes off glasses) What the-- (A PFT bus drives away.) Uh, No! No! Wait! Uggggg... (Candace stops. She turns around, notices a PFT poster on a building and smiles) MMMMMOOOOM?!? (She runs back inside.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Sorry, Perry the Platypus, but you are too late!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (still in a store; wearing a jacket) Ooh, this one's nice.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Come here! You've gotta see this! (She drags her out...)

Name: Linda
Dialog: (setting off the shoplifting alarm) But Candace! I haven't paid for this yet!

Name: Guard
Dialog: Hey!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (inside his giant walking building robot) Ha ha ha ha! When it comes to havoc, nobody wreaks like me! (Perry removes a metal cover of a storage) Whoa! Wait wait, you're not supposed to touch that! (Perry removes a wire) Hey, hey, no fair! (The robot almost steps over the building, but turns around.)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Wow, what a great painting! (Phineas is playing his guitar) How did you get permission for that?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, they didn't mind. The building's scheduled for demolition. (A man presses the lever of a dynamite block. The building gets demolished, along with the poster, just as Candace drags her mom out.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Seeeeeee??!! (Linda does not answer. Candace turns and sees the building is gone.) Aaaahhhh!!

Name: Guard
Dialog: Uh, ma'am, you're gonna have to come back and pay for that.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (flatly) Yes of course, officer. (follows him)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Aaaahhhh!!

Name: Guard
Dialog: Hey, weren't you Lindana?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Yes, I was! I can't believe you recognized me.

Name: Guard
Dialog: Well, I was a huge fan. (pauses, serious) You still have to pay for the jacket.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (flatly) I know.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Very clever, Perry the Platypus. I was trying to ignore you, but you forced my hand. (Pushes a button and traps Perry) And now...I shall relax with a nice, tasty deli platter. Oh-ho-ho, where are my manners? (Gives Perry his share) Here you go, Perry the Platypus. Care for some pepper? Just say when. (Continues to pour pepper) Anytime.

Name: Ben
Dialog: (from the boardroom) Boys, let me start by saying we love your act and we want to be in the Phineas and the Ferb-Tones business. Uh by the way, aren't you a little young to be pop stars? (Pause)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: ...No. (Another pause)

Name: Ben
Dialog: Well, okay then! We're prepared to offer you a very lucrative contract if you'll just sign exclusively with us for your follow-up single.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (suddenly angry) Follow-up single?! Who do you think we are, (He rips up the contract.) some two-bit hacks who will keep writing new songs just because you pay us obscene amounts of cash?! (The band enters the elevator.) Phineas and the Ferb-Tones are strictly a one-hit wonder! Good day to you, sir! (In the elevator, "Gitchee Gitchee Goo" plays as elevator music.; to Ferb) Diva tantrum, check. (Pauses, listens to the "Gitchee Gitchee Goo" elevator music.) Elevator music, check. (Ferb checks off "Elevator music".)

Name: Ben
Dialog: (Doof's robot is approaching from the window behind him) Ah, who needs 'em? We've still got this video tape of their performance. We can do live CDs, DVDs, podcasts, heck, we can digitally re-create their images to make our own sitcom! The Phineas and Ferb Show! We can squeeze twenty years of entertainment out of this one video tape.

Name: Manager
Dialog: (screams) That giant robot's coming right at us!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (still pouring pepper) Wow, you sure like a lot of pepper. I'm more of a paprika man myself. (Perry blows over the pepper, Dr. D coughs) It will take more than condiments to foil my brilliant plan! (The robot sneezes them out, and they crash through the Huge-O-Records building.)

Name: Ben
Dialog: (Perry grabs the band's evidence) The tape!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aaaahhh! (Perry loosens the tape's film and successfully lands) Aaaaaaaahhhhh!!! (Lands on a soft mattress; Below...) Whew! What an unbelievable stroke of luck! (The mattress folds in half) Oof! I'm okay! I'm still better than the... (gets stepped over by the robot) Curse you, Perry the Platypus!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (the platypus arrives in pet mode) Oh, there you are, Perry. (Perry chatters; a bus reading "PFT Reunion Concert" pulls up and they get on.) Come on, guys. We still have one thing left to do. (The bus pulls away)

Name: Phil
Dialog: And the winner of today's "Next Super American Pop Teen Idol Star" is... (Screen zooms out to reveal:) Marty the Rabbit Boy and his Musical Blender! (as the camera pans to the moping Candace on a bench) Oh, give him a hand! He's going to Hollywood!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (walks over) Hey, Candace. What's wrong?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm better than that guy. Oh, I should've taken blender lessons.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: So why did you run off earlier?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Groans) My brothers. (sighs) They always ruin everything.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Well, you like to sing, right?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Then you shouldn't let your brothers' fun ruin your good time. You know, if you get a chance to sing, you oughta sing. I gotta go, I'll see you later. (Walks away)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey Candace. (Shows the stage for the PFT Reunion Concert) You're still the hundredth contestant, wanna come up and help us out? (Candace walks onstage.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: That was great! I've been thinking of my brothers all wrong! They're not a nuisance. They're my ticket to-

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Thanks, you've been great! This is the last time we're ever gonna sing that song. We're retiring, good night! (The band walks offstage; the lights switch off, leaving Candace in the dark with her eyes still visible.)

Name: Mall Operator
Dialog: (via loud speaker) The mall is now closed and will re-open at 9:00 A.M. tomorrow. Thank you for shopping with us. (Candace's eyes blink then cuts to black, as the guitar stinger plays.)

Name: Announcer
Dialog: You loved her in the '80s. Get ready to love her again. Lindana's mega hit "I'm Lindana and I Wanna Have Fun", has been remixed and re-translated into your favorite languages: Portuguese! Dutch! Canadian! Japanese! Esperanto! Pig Latin! Dog! And everyone's favorite-

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, Mom. Whatcha watchin'?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, nothing.
